remediation.rationale: The exact upstream 6.4.1 release is ESM-only and would require a materially broader module/global/worker-loader migration. The backport applies the upstream sanitizer implementation and exact attribute-snapshot security fix to the v4.7.1 source, builds a new local browser artifact, and preserves the maintained classic script/global maplibregl loading contract.

upstream.security_patch_behavior: Snapshot elem.attributes with Array.from before removing dangerous attributes, preventing live NamedNodeMap mutation from skipping an adjacent dangerous attribute.

local_identity.origin: locally patched derivative from exact upstream v4.7.1 source

exposure_and_contract.attribution_control: AttributionControl now sanitizes custom attribution HTML before assigning innerHTML; the maintained app does not expose a user/custom attribution input.
exposure_and_contract.canonical_user_data_guard: Canonical data/provider validation and the added regression require the fixed Smart-map and Satellite attribution contract and reject arbitrary customAttribution/user HTML paths absent a future security review.
